labelChirho: a liar, one who speaks falsehood
descriptionChirho: A person who tells lies or is characterized by falsehood; Greek ψεύστης denotes one whose speech is deceptive or untruthful. Multilingual evidence is consistent: eng 'liar(s),' spa 'mentiroso(s),' hin झूठा (jhūṭhā, liar), arb كَذّابٌ/كَذّابونَ (kadhdhāb, habitual liar), kor 거짓말쟁이(들) (geojitmaljaeng-i), swa 'mwongo/waongo' (liar/liars). The split is purely grammatical number: singular nominative/accusative (S79188) vs plural dative/nominative (S79189) with identical semantic content.
